content_of_post_to_comment: Not sure if anyone else is in a similar position but I work in sales and my job is just making calls all day. Now I always make the calls that’s not the problem, it’s just that in sales you might go an hour or two not speaking to anyone while dialing. There is a lot of downtime and I usually fill this with just scrolling Reddit or YouTube but I’m wondering if anyone has any better ideas as to how to fill the time instead.
comment: I used to think downtime between calls was just wasted time, but those gaps are actually useful because they’re predictable. I’d avoid replacing Reddit/YouTube with another endless scroll and pick things you can pause instantly: audiobooks, language practice, sales podcasts, or even reviewing your call notes. The trick is having something that works in 5-minute chunks.
